field_mapping.$.start_time: startTimeUnixNano losslessly converted to UTC microsecond time
field_mapping.$.end_time: endTimeUnixNano losslessly converted to UTC microsecond time
field_mapping.$.prompt_tokens: span attribute llm.token_count.prompt as canonical decimal string
field_mapping.$.completion_tokens: span attribute llm.token_count.completion as canonical decimal string
field_mapping.$.total_tokens: span attribute llm.token_count.total as canonical decimal string
field_mapping.$.missing_parent: true only when parent_span_id is declared but the same trace_id + parent_span_id identity is absent from the sanitized LLM records in this bounded bundle

strictness: count both selected and skipped spans toward max_spans=200 and reject the complete bundle above that bound
reject trace_id, span_id or parent_span_id outside the lowercase hexadecimal Source shape after deterministic lowercasing
accept only OTLP status UNSET/OK/ERROR in symbolic or numeric 0/1/2 form; reject unknown status codes
reject token counters not encoded as protobuf JSON strings
preserve each observed token counter independently; check prompt plus completion versus total only when all three are observed
resolve parent presence within the same trace_id and sanitized LLM batch only
preserve source-derived opaque UTF-8 without NFC normalization
